tei:div.tei:p: 575)༄༅/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub rgyun gyi phrin las gzhan phan mkha' khyab bzhugs//

phyogs dus bde gshegs thams cad kyi// ngo bor gyur pa 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can// spyan ras gzigs dbang zhabs la 'dud// de nyid gsang ba 'dus pa'i mthar thug sgrub pa'i snying po 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ gsang ba'i dam rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan dzā gad kyis gang bar dkar gsum mngar gsum a mṛ ta/ byang sems dkar dmar/ sin+dhu ra rnams sbyar la dar dmar pos dril te lding gur phub pa'i mdun sman raka gtor ma/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams 'du bya/ sgrub pa po rgyud ston pa dang ldan pas thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni/ kye maḥ bdag gi 'gro kun bsgral bya'i phyir: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par bskul: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do: bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren 576) bgegs kyi tshogs: nga ni 'jigs byed dbang gi sku: bka' 'das rdul phran bzhin du brlag: de bas rang gi gnas su dengs: hūm̐ bzhi brjod/ mtshams bcad ni/ hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin dbang gi sku: sku las mtshon cha'i thog ser 'phro: bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag 'khrugs: khro chung tshogs kyis bgegs rnams brlag: badz+ra rak+sha: byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐ hrī: rnam dag spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las: ma 'gags thugs rje'i rang rtsal gtso dang 'khor: gnas 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi byin phob la: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: rtsa sngags/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sarba sa ma ya a we sha ya a: mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ hrī: gsang 'dus thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs rnams: snang srid thams cad yongs bkang nas: gus pas 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol:

oṃ badz+ra pu+uṣ+pe nas/ shab+ta āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā ba liṃ ta ma hā rak+ta bho dhi tsit+ta ga na gu h+ya sarba pū dzaḥ.āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa 577) rten dang brten pa'i lha bskyed pa/ hūm̐: spros med chos rnams ye nas dag: de nyid ma rtogs snying re rje: hrīḥni ye shes snying po'i srog: dug lnga gnas su dag pa las: dbang chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong dbus: pho brang mnyam yangs 'od du 'khyil: dal dbus 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i klong: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rang rig yi ge hrīḥdamar po: phar 'phros rgyal ba mnyes mchod 'bul: sems can kun gyi sgrib pa sbyangs: tshur 'dus dngos grub bdag la bsdu: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par bsam: de nyid yongs su gyur pa las: rang rig gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku: dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas pad phreng thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon tshe bum pad sdong bsnams: rin chen pad phreng rus rgyan dang: dar dpyangs rgyan sogs dpag med rgyan: bde mchog gsang ba ye shes ma: phyag g.yas ut+pal g.yon bdud rtsi: zung 'jug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: gcer bu rgyan 578) drug pad phreng mdzes: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril: gnyis med zung 'jug dag tu bsgom: 'khor rnams mos bskyed tsam bya na/ rigs bdag mtha' yas sku mdog dmar: thugs kar rta mgrin rngams brjid 'jigs: nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin rigs lngar bcas: sems dpa' yab yum thub pa drug: sangs rgyas stong rtsa sgo ba bzhi: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: gang 'dul sgyu ma'i rol par shar: kun kyang ma 'dres 'ja' ltar bsgom: oṃm ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sarba bha ga wan ma ṇi badz+ra a: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha sa ma ya s+t+wam̐ sa ma ya dza: spyan drang ba ni/ hrī: rnam dag bde chen gzhal yas nas: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī:

sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ ba ྃho: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hrī: dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: dbye gsal med par bzhugs su gsol: thugs rje'i rang rtsal zhi dang khror: sgo gsum dad pas phyag bgyi'o: badz+ra 579) sa ma ya tiṇ+ṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga: thabs shes gnyis med bde bas mchod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= shab+da ma hā pañtsa bho dhi tsit+ta pū dzaḥho: sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hrī: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: rang byung 'khor 'das gtor mar sbyar: 'dod chags rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs: thugs rje'i lha tshogs bzhes su gsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling ta rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: sbyor sgrol de nyid mchod pa ni/ hrī: thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med: dug lnga rang grol ye shes lnga: spros pa med pa dbyings kyi ngang: ye mchod chen por bzhes su gsol: tā na gā na swa bhā wa pū dza ho: bstod pa ni/ hrī: bdai gshegs kun 'dus thugs rje'i lha: rang byung ye shes spyan ras gzigs: dmar gsal pad phreng bum pa 'dzin: gsang ye rang 'dra'i yum dang 'khril: rab mdzes rgyan rdzogs 'od lnga'i 580) klong: nyi zla pad stong dgyes par bzhugs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal bstaud: tshe yi bdag po rta mgrin dbang: nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin rigs lngar bcas: sems dpa' yab yum thub pa drug: sangs rgyas stong rtsa sgo ba bzhi: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can bcas: yongs rjogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstaud: bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng: hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer can: yig drug mtha' la bskor bar bsam: de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur bsam:

bdag nyid thugs srog hrīḥyig las: 'od zer phar 'phros rgyal ba mchod: sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: kun kyang thugs rje chen por gyur: tshur 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi bcud: byin rlabs dngos grub bdag la thim: ting 'dzin thugs srog hrī yi mthar: yig drug g.yon du bskor bar bsgom: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ (581)hrī: yig bdun chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla// gsum pa rjes la tshogs mchod ni// zas sna yo byad tshogs tshad bsags// dang po sbyong zhing byin rlabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus: tshogs rdzas 'dod yon snang srid gang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrī: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: thugs rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: ye shes tshogs la gshegs su gsol: e h+ya he sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: mchod pa ni/ hrī: gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa ni: 'dod pa'i longs spyod sprin tshogs gtibs: bde chen lha mo gar gyis bsgyur: mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bshags pa ni/ bdag cag ma rig rmongs gyur te: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang: bskang nas dngos grub stsal du gsol: 582) badz+ra sa ma ya shu d+dhe a: bsgral bstabs ni/ e nṛ tri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ḥ nga ni rab 'jigs dbang gi rgyal: gnam lcags phur pa mkha' la 'dril: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du brlag: sha khrag rus pa zhal du bstab: dgra bgegs sha trum̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs la rol nas/ lhag ma ni/ hrī: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud tshogs: dbang chen rta yi bka' sdod rnams: bka' yi pham phab 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hrīḥbh+yo ba ling+ta khā hi:

bskul pa ni/ hrī: ma bcos lhun grub bde chen zhing khams nas: rang byung ye shes thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams: ma 'gags 'gro ba 'dul bar thugs dam bskul: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: chad tho ni/ hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng gis: 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam (583)pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bh+yo: 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: khyed rnams sngon gyi zhal bzhes g.yar dam can: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor 'khor srung rkyen zlog bar chad sol: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: rta bro ni/ hrī: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: gtum chen rngams pa'i sgra sgrog cing: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: khro bo'i 'brug hūm̐ sgra ti ri ri: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog: rta mgrin sngags dang*/ ya ma dam sri s+t+wam̐ bha ya nan: dngos grub blang ba ni/ bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyis: tshul bzhin sgrub (584)pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe dang chos dang phrin las rnam bzhi sogs: mchog dang thun mong 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol: a la la ho: nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang: gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas: 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa: de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs: yig brgya bzla/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gis bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: kyis lhar ldang / bsngo smon ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs:

bdag gi dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin phyir bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: shis brjod ni/ dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas gter: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don kun grub: dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: de ltar sgrub la nan tan bskyed// thugs rje che dang gnyis med 'gyur: 585) zhib par gter gzhung las shes so/ zhes pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i slob bu ma hā su kha'i mtshan can gyi thugs dam lhag pa'i lhar bzung nas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yan lag tshang ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ngo chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i byin rlabs cha tsam thob pa pad+ma ma ṇis gter gzhung gab sprad tshig bsdus te bkod pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o// ༄/ hrī: rigs kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir// snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir// gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang*// 'gro drug thugs rjes 'dren pa'i phyir// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bka' dang bstan pa srung ba'i phyir// bka' srung gter srung thugs dam bskang*// bsod nams phun tshogs thob pa'i phyir// longs spyod tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ khyed kyi thugs dam bskang gyur nas// bdag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam tshig chags nyams bskang ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ zhes bskang*/ de nas bar bshags la 'jug ces pa'ang ma hā su kha'i ngor chags med gsung las btus pa'o// dge'o// 586)
